title: Trend narrative output
description: Output of the Sonnet trend-narrative prompt — one object per digest.

headline.description: Single sentence describing this week's most notable movement. Must mention specific topics.

movements.description: 1–6 direction-changes this week, prioritized by operator-interest overlap.

cluster_label.description: Label of the cluster this movement describes. Must match an existing cluster label for this week.

direction.description: See PROJECT_BRIEF.md §6 step 9 and prompts/trend_narrative.md for strict thresholds.

narrative.description: Why this direction, how big, and what it likely means for the operator.

key_papers.description: 1–3 representative arXiv IDs driving the movement.

cross_domain_observation.description: Bridge linking movements across normally-disjoint sub-fields. Empty string is correct when no genuine bridge appears this week.

weekly_question.description: Specific, actionable question the operator could productively investigate this week. Not philosophical.
